Feedback timing was a sore point—grading comments were detailed, but they came after I’d already turned in the next items, which was frustrating. One memorable week was the big week of the midterm experiments; that lot of data juggling and interpretation stuck with me. Overall, I wouldn’t call it a smooth ride, but I walked away with a clearer sense of how to frame a project and tune a model under real constraints.
